# 2 Baruch Chapter 40 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Third Fast and Vision

---

**1** And the dominion of my Anointed One which has been revealed will stand forever, until the world of corruption has ended and until the times that have been spoken of above are fulfilled.

**2** This is the vision which you saw, and this is its interpretation.

**3** And I said: O Lord my Lord, will I also be preserved until those times? Or who will be in those days?

**4** And he answered and said to me: Whatever will be with you — you will not know; but whatever concerns you — that you will know; for the Most High has revealed these things to you.

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal equivalence rendering. The formal closing of the vision and its interpretation (v.2). Baruch's question about personal preservation (v.3) receives a partial answer: personal matters will be revealed; the full sweep of future history will not.*
